newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Fiat says checking Brava problem.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Fiat says checking Brava problem.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat was still carrying out checks to determine the extent of problems with the braking system on its Brava saloon model, a company spokesman said.

The spokesman said it was too early to say whether a full recall of the model would be necessary because it was not yet clear whether the problems, which had been identified in Germany, were limited to a few cases or were more extensive.

Earlier Germany's Bild Zeitung quoted a Fiat spokesman as saying the 1.4 litre engine version of the, named car of the year in 1996, would be affected by a recall but did not say how many vehicles would be affected.
